title: eupatorium perfoliatum f. truncatum
intro: Eupatorium perfoliatum f. truncatum, commonly known as Joe Pye Weed, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Eupatorium perfoliatum f. truncatum include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diaphoretic properties, which can help reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote sweating. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
